0022600203.text: The Atlanta Hawks host the Los Angeles Lakers in the Hawks' 12th game of the season, with Atlanta at 7-4 and first in the Southeast, fourth in the East, on a four-game winning streak. The Lakers come in at 8-2, first in the Pacific and third in the West, also on a four-game winning streak, while Atlanta is without Asa Newell, Henri Veesaar, Jock Landale, Keshon Gilbert and Mouhamed Gueye and Los Angeles is without Luka Doncic. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 and split their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the Lakers beat the Hawks 141-116 in their last meeting, on January 13, 2026, in Los Angeles.
